text: Given the connector is running, When tools/list is called, Then it returns exactly 16 digitalocean_kubernetes_* tools, each with description first-line <=100 chars, full text <=500 chars, and correct readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint

Given a tools/call request missing the X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token header, When any Kubernetes tool is invoked, Then the response is HTTP 401 and the body lists the required header name, and the mocked upstream client is never invoked

Given 60 mocked clusters, When digitalocean_kubernetes_list_clusters is called with no arguments, Then it returns 50 with has_more=true; given 250 mocked clusters, When called with limit=500, Then it returns at most 200

Given a mocked cluster, When digitalocean_kubernetes_get_cluster is called with no flags, Then it returns spec/status/node-pool summary; When called with include_upgrades=true, Then it also includes the mocked available-upgrades list (including an empty-list case); When called with include_status_messages=true, Then it also includes mocked status messages; given an unknown id, Then it returns a structured not_found error

Given a mocked 422 validation response from DigitalOcean, When digitalocean_kubernetes_create_cluster is called, Then the error is surfaced as a structured invalid_argument carrying DigitalOcean's message

Given an existing cluster, When digitalocean_kubernetes_update_cluster is called with only {"tags": ["prod"]}, Then the outbound request body contains only that field and the tool description text states this is a partial update (not a full-spec replace)

Given no version argument, When digitalocean_kubernetes_upgrade_cluster is called, Then it is rejected with invalid_argument before any HTTP call; given an explicit version, Then it triggers the mocked upgrade endpoint and is annotated destructiveHint=true

Given a mocked cluster with associated load balancers, volumes, and volume snapshots, When digitalocean_kubernetes_list_cluster_resources is called, Then it returns each with id and name, annotated readOnlyHint=true

Given digitalocean_kubernetes_delete_cluster is called with no mode, Then it is rejected before any HTTP call; mode=plain calls only the plain DELETE; mode=selective without explicit id lists is rejected, with id lists calls the selective-destroy endpoint with exactly those ids; mode=dangerous calls the dangerous-destroy endpoint and the tool description text states irreversibility
Given a mocked kubeconfig response, When digitalocean_kubernetes_get_kubeconfig is called, Then it returns the raw YAML string unmodified, and the value never appears in captured log output

Given a mocked credentials response, When digitalocean_kubernetes_get_credentials is called, Then it returns the structured bundle (server/token/expires_at), distinct in shape from TC10's YAML string, and the token value never appears in captured log output

Given mocked node pools, When digitalocean_kubernetes_list_node_pools or get_node_pool is called, Then it returns name/size/count/labels/taints/autoscale/node fields; given an unknown pool id, Then it returns not_found

Given a mocked min_nodes/max_nodes inconsistency response (auto_scale=true, min_nodes=5, max_nodes=3), When digitalocean_kubernetes_create_node_pool is called, Then it surfaces a structured invalid_argument error
Given digitalocean_kubernetes_update_node_pool resizing count, Then it is annotated idempotentHint=true and two identical mocked calls in sequence produce the same resulting state

Given digitalocean_kubernetes_delete_node_pool is called with no node_pool_id, Then it is rejected; given an explicit id, Then it calls the mocked DELETE and the tool description text states irreversibility

Given digitalocean_kubernetes_delete_node is called missing cluster_id/node_pool_id/node_id, Then it is rejected; replace=false (default) calls DELETE with replace=0; replace=true calls DELETE with replace=1 and the description text states this is the modern replacement for the deprecated recycle endpoint; the tool signature has no bulk/list argument

Given a mocked options response, When digitalocean_kubernetes_get_deployment_options is called with no arguments, Then it returns regions/versions/sizes, annotated readOnlyHint=true and idempotentHint=true

Given two concurrent tools/call requests carrying two different tenants' X-DigitalOcean-Api-Token values, When both complete, Then each sees only its own token in the outbound Authorization header and only its own response data

Given a mocked 429 response with Retry-After, When a tool call is in flight, Then it retries with backoff honoring Retry-After and, once the budget is exhausted, returns rate_limited; given a mocked 503, Then it retries and, once exhausted, returns upstream_error
